## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case? A clear description
of *why* helps more than a proposed solution alone.

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

## Impact on the design

- [ ] Keeps hard policy logic in code (not prompts)
- [ ] Preserves engine parity (all engines produce identical verdicts)
- [ ] Keeps the base install / CI key-free

## Additional context

Links, references, or examples that would help.
